verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Unity's editor extensibility, C# scripting APIs, CLI, and MCP integration, but contains no mention of an official language server (LSP) or typed API definitions specifically packaged for coding-agent editors to attach to for completions/diagnostics/navigation — Unity relies on generic C# tooling (Visual Studio/Rider/OmniSharp) which isn't documented here as a first-party Unity deliverable.
